description: This file implements authentication API endpoints for a sports live-stream platform backend using FastAPI. It provides user login, profile retrieval, profile updating, and token refresh functions, utilizing dependencies like database repositories, models, and utility functions.

methods.name: login_user( login_data: UserLogin = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles user authentication by verifying email and password, returning a mock JWT token and user info.

methods.name: get_current_user_profile( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves the profile of the currently authenticated or trusted user.

methods.name: update_current_user_profile( user_update: UserUpdate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates the profile information of the trusted/mock user.

methods.name: refresh_access_token( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Provides a token refresh endpoint, returning a new mock token.
